title: Menu music plays in every scene and from headless agent JVMs; only the main menu (and game) should play it
user-messages: also I am hearing music that I wrote from some jvm, only the main menu scene and game should be playing not the model scene and scenes generally
description: Scene.initGL and Scene.activate(true) start AudioAssets.MENU_MUSIC for every scene, so the model, quad-layout and every other tool scene loop the user's menu track; only MainScene and TradeScene opt out by pausing it. HeadlessPlatform.audio() returns the real OpenAL AudioSystem, so every headless scene an agent or ixdar-cli runs plays out loud too. Make menu music opt-in per scene (the main menu, scene id ixdar, MenuScene) and keep headless audio silent while its state stays observable to the audio-state/audio-log routes.
definition-of-done: 1. A scene plays the menu music only when it opts in; MenuScene (id ixdar) does, the model scenes and tool scenes do not. 2. A headless scene never makes sound, while audio-state/audio-log still report what it would play. 3. The trade game's music behaviour is whatever the user decides (asked in the report). 4. Build checkstyle-green; audio tests pass.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test: a plain scene's activate does not start menu music; MenuScene's does (through a stand-in AudioBackend). 2. Headless run of quad-layout: audio-state shows no music playing. 3. Existing audio tests.
